Path: the customer's language | i18n.surface-matrix | P2

## Triage: first grade (closure card for the inspector English family) — `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:i18n` · `pm:queue`

Triage: lands in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/` (the sites the table names) and new `engine.*` rows in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` ⇒ `domain:ui`. Rationale: designer inspectors still render English under zh-CN wherever no catalogue row exists. That covers widget-type labels, lookup operators, `VariableTextInput`, the `useFlowScope` group headings, `expression-validate` messages and more. Two at-tier contract reviews re-walked all 44 inspector sources and confirmed the list (`5852290145`, `5852542302`). The family grade is p3 (objectui#10586, objectui#10696, both closed) ⇒ **p3**. This card becomes the family's closure card.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01W89enF2dYV7K4N2Fbfj33f` · 2026-09-27T05:19Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card (no comments), objectui#10696's thread, objectui#10586 and objectui#4662.

**Why this is not a decision card.** The body frames 「add rows, or leave a named subset in English」 as the decision. It is already answered by precedent: objectui#10586 (PR objectui#10678) added about 115 new `engine.*` rows, en-US plus zh-CN, for this same family. objectui#10696's 「no key added here」 was that card's own scope fence (its listing says 「⛔ no key added here」), not a rule against rows. ⇒ **Direction: add rows in the objectui#10586 shape.** The 「left literal on purpose」 list in the body (the objectui#10678 / objectui#10651 ruling) stays literal. ⛔ Do not translate code samples, stored values or author data.

**Execution note.**
- One zh case per site, with a lit control on the same mount; objectui#10741's `inspectorStrings.i18n-10696.test.tsx` is the template.
- For `LOOKUP_OPERATORS`, reuse the four partial `engine.inspector.condition.op.*` rows only where the symbol prefix stays outside the translated word.
